surface_mechanism_description: The formation of Hf-silicide at Hf-silicate/Si interfaces was induced by the reaction of metallic Hf atoms with Si substrate atoms. The presence of Al2O3 interlayers suppressed this formation. Thicker Al2O3 layers blocked the direct reaction of Hf atoms with Si substrate atoms, thus dynamically suppressing Hf-silicide formation.
evidence: The formation of Hf-silicide at Hf-silicate/Si interfaces was induced by the reaction of metallic Hf atoms with Si substrate atoms; this formation was suppressed by the presence of Al2O3 interlayers between Hf-silicate and Si. ... unoxidized, metallic Hf atoms diffused through the Al2O3 interlayers and reacted with the Si substrate, thus forming Hf-silicide.
